question: What is the primary function of family planning reporting in a national health system?

options.A: Generating data for commodity forecasting and health planning
options.B: Assessing nurse performance and productivity bonuses
options.C: Determining patient ability to pay for services
options.D: Tracking individual client medical histories for research

explanation: Service statistics collected from facilities allow health authorities to predict commodity needs and allocate resources effectively. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h1)

question: Why is proper documentation considered as important as direct clinical care in family planning services?

options.A: It prevents commodity stockouts and secures future supplies
options.B: It ensures legal protection for the healthcare provider
options.C: It eliminates the need for patient follow-up visits
options.D: It reduces the financial cost of purchasing contraceptives

explanation: Accurate tallies and reports feed directly into the supply chain pipeline, ensuring clinics do not run out of essential contraceptives. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h1)

question: What is a direct benefit of tracking client attendance patterns at a family planning clinic?

options.B: Calculating the exact birth rate of the entire country
options.D: Determining appropriate facility staffing and operating hours

explanation: Client attendance data helps nurse managers understand peak periods and deploy staff efficiently to meet community demand. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h2)

question: How do reproductive health data directly impact international health funding?

options.A: Data collection directly sets the exchange rate for health commodities
options.B: Local clinics use data to buy foreign currency for drug importation
options.C: Donors require documented evidence of service uptake before releasing grants
options.D: International agencies use data to audit individual nurses' salaries

explanation: Reliable statistics demonstrate program impact, which reassures donors and justifies continued financial and material support. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h2)

question: How is a 'new acceptor' defined in family planning service statistics?

options.A: A patient switching from pills to an injectable method
options.B: An individual adopting a modern contraceptive method for the first time
options.C: A client visiting the health facility for the first time ever
options.D: A client returning for a routine annual resupply

explanation: A new acceptor refers specifically to someone starting modern contraception use for the first time in their life. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h3)

question: What does the metric known as Couple-Years of Protection (CYP) actually measure?

options.A: The estimated duration of protection provided by distributed contraceptives
options.B: The physical lifespan of a contraceptive implant or IUD
options.C: The exact number of pregnancies prevented in a local government area
options.D: The total financial cost of protecting a couple from sexually transmitted infections

explanation: CYP calculates the estimated protection time generated by the quantity of various contraceptives distributed to clients over a year. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h3)

question: When should entries be made into the daily family planning client register?

options.A: At the end of each working week
options.B: During the monthly data collation meeting
options.C: Only when an external supervisor visits the clinic
options.D: Immediately during or right after the client consultation

explanation: Real-time documentation prevents omissions and ensures that client details are recorded accurately while fresh. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h4)

question: What is the primary practical advantage of using tally sheets alongside client registers?

options.A: They automatically calculate the expiry dates of stored contraceptives
options.B: They allow quick real-time counting without recalculating registers at month-end
options.C: They replace the need for physical client folders entirely
options.D: They provide a secure legal contract between the nurse and the client

explanation: Tally sheets accumulate daily tick marks, making it fast and easy to sum up monthly totals without tedious page-by-page counting. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h4)

question: Which document serves as the primary source for completing the Monthly Summary Form?

options.A: Daily tally sheets and client registers

explanation: Monthly summaries are compiled by aggregating the raw data captured daily in tally sheets and client registers. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h5)

question: Why is cross-checking tally sheets against register entries essential before submitting monthly forms?

options.A: It guarantees internal data consistency and uncovers counting errors
options.B: It automatically orders new contraceptive stock from the central warehouse
options.C: It calculates the exact salaries owed to the clinic staff
options.D: It registers the clinic for international accreditation

explanation: Comparing tally sheets and registers helps catch discrepancies and mathematical mistakes before the report leaves the facility. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h5)

question: What does a discrepancy between reported contraceptive distribution and stock card consumption indicate?

options.C: A potential data reporting or inventory error
options.D: Extended shelf life of the pharmaceutical products

explanation: Service outputs must align logically with inventory consumption; mismatches signal reporting mistakes or stock mismanagement. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h6)

question: Which of the following is NOT considered a core dimension of data quality?
explanation: Data quality dimensions focus on reliability, such as accuracy, completeness, consistency, and timeliness, rather than how complex the data is. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h6)

question: What is the name of the electronic platform commonly used for reporting health data in Nigeria?
explanation: DHIS2 serves as the primary electronic platform for aggregating and managing routine health data across Nigerian health facilities. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h7)

question: What is the primary consequence of consistently submitting facility health reports after the established monthly deadline?

options.A: Permanent deletion of all previous years' electronic records
options.B: Immediate closure of the health facility by federal inspectors
options.C: Disruption of national commodity logistics and delayed planning
options.D: Automatic promotion of the facility's head nurse

explanation: Late reporting prevents central authorities from compiling timely national figures, which delays forecasting and commodity distribution. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h7)

question: Who is the primary local beneficiary when family planning data is analyzed at the facility level?

options.A: Pharmaceutical manufacturing companies in foreign countries
options.B: Federal legislators drafting national tax laws
options.D: The clinic staff and nurse managers planning local interventions

explanation: Local data analysis helps facility staff identify service gaps, track trends, and adjust their own clinical strategies. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h8)

question: A clinic nurse notices through monthly data review that clients are exclusively requesting emergency contraception while ignoring ongoing methods. What action should follow?

options.A: Initiate targeted client counseling and education on long-term options
options.B: Hide the emergency contraception data from the monthly summary form
options.C: Refer all clients immediately to tertiary teaching hospitals

explanation: Identifying method over-reliance allows nurses to address knowledge gaps and promote comprehensive contraceptive counseling. [learn more](GNS226_U6_T028#GNS226_U6_T028_h8)
